_comment: Font provider for the parchment UI theme.
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt in this directory).
Per the OFL, OFL.txt MUST ship alongside the TTF binary in
the same directory whenever the font is redistributed.
Note: the variable TTF (Newsreader[opsz,wght].ttf) was tried first but
MC 1.21.1's TTF provider returned .notdef for every glyph against it,
so we ship the static 16pt Regular cut here instead. 16pt matches the
optical size the body-text UI uses.
If the type looks oversized/tiny, tune `size`, `shift`, and `oversample`
below. The vanilla default is chained as a fallback so any glyph the
TTF doesn't cover (e.g. some symbols) still draws.
Pack authors can override this file entirely from a resource pack to
swap in their own TTF or fall back to vanilla pixel text.
